text:
Pricing refinement follows the supplied plan. The original Images #1–#3 were not attached in this context, so exact comparison against those references remains unavailable.

Changes apply to `/pricing`: distinct card and comparison surfaces, shaded stats strips and group headings, solid circular check badges, shared card rows for price/action/link/stats alignment, consolidated header rules matching landing gutters and its 1024px breakpoint, and removal of the hero attribution. Landing pricing, billing behavior, localization, authentication, and theme entitlement logic are unchanged.

Verification commands:

```sh
npm run check:colors
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npx tsx scripts/test-usage-db.ts --e2e-only --browser=pricing --output=test-results/pricing-refinement
```

All checks passed; the final browser run passed 16/16 tests.

The browser suite covers signed-out, Free, and Premium states on desktop and mobile Chromium. Visual checks cover Lavender, Nightbloom, Chalk, and Obsidian at 1440, 820, 390, and 360px. It checks axe accessibility, page overflow, card alignment, solid badges, keyboard table scrolling, menu placement and keyboard access, theme persistence and gating, localized prices, current-plan actions, hover lift/glow, and reduced motion.

Check badge ink/fill contrast measured in Chromium: Lavender 6.28:1, Nightbloom 6.05:1, Chalk 17.93:1, Obsidian 16.91:1.

Screenshots are in [screenshots](./screenshots/), named by theme and viewport width. Narrow screenshots show the left edge of the internally scrollable comparison table; the browser tests verify that keyboard scrolling reveals the remaining columns.
